hero.title: Build Your Perfect Body
hero.description: Join IRON GYM, where passion meets performance. Our state-of-the-art facilities and expert trainers are dedicated to helping you achieve your fitness goals and transform your life.

programs.title: OUR PROGRAM
programs.subtitle: BUILD YOUR BEST BODY
programs.description: Looking to start a new routine at the gym? Try our specially designed workouts led by expert trainers to build strength and confidence.

cutting.title: CUTTING
cutting.description: Achieve a lean, defined physique with our cutting program designed to reduce body fat while maintaining muscle mass through targeted exercises and nutrition.

bulking.title: BULKING
bulking.description: Build significant muscle mass with our bulking program, combining progressive overload training with proper nutrition to maximize muscle growth.

cardio.title: CARDIO
cardio.description: Improve your cardiovascular health and endurance with our diverse cardio program, featuring HIIT, steady-state cardio, and functional training.

professionalTrainer.title: PROFESSIONAL TRAINER
professionalTrainer.description: Our certified personal trainers create customized workout plans tailored to your specific goals, ensuring you maximize every session.

goodManagement.title: GOOD MANAGEMENT
goodManagement.description: Our dedicated staff ensures all equipment is well-maintained, facilities are clean, and your experience is seamless from check-in to check-out.

open247.title: OPEN 24/7
open247.description: Train whenever it suits you with our 24/7 access. Whether you're an early bird or a night owl, our gym is always open to help you achieve your fitness goals.
